description: Wait for a check (or a confirm_fix re-check) and read its result: how many problems a new user would hit and the title of each; once the app is paid for ($9 for that app; this gives the payment link), for each one what a new user saw, where, the likely cause, the fix prompt and how to know it is fixed. Waits up to about 4 minutes; if it says the check is still running, call it again with the same check_id.
name: get_check_result
title: Read what the check found
